data.why: Neurosift browses and visualizes NWB files hosted on the public DANDI Archive (fetched by URL over the network); no local upload or seed file is needed.

goals: Search DANDI for a dandiset of interest and open one of its NWB assets
Browse the internal group/dataset structure (neurodata types) of an opened NWB file
View a continuous ephys or behavioural timeseries as an interactive, pannable/zoomable line plot
View spike trains as a raster plot and inspect PSTH/firing-rate summaries for units
View two-photon/imaging summary images and ROI masks for an Ophys NWB file
Generate a ready-to-run Python snippet (PyNWB/h5py/remfile) that reproduces an on-screen view

review.summary: The tree follows Neurosift's real workflow: search DANDI, open an NWB asset without downloading it, check its metadata and HDF5 structure, view rasters, PSTHs and ophys images, and get Python code. Most cited screens show what their nodes claim. Before filing it needs a real continuous-signal view (058 shows a flat line still loading), branch markers on the right level, and coverage of the other archives and local files the README names.
